geo_basis: country; both payment companies are South Korean per ZDNet Korea; no city stated
date_note: Day KIS says the abnormal access happened (NHN KCP: 17 November); the article, published 24 November, gives no disclosure day.
title: KIS Information & Telecommunication and NHN KCP report abnormal access that leaked data, ZDNet Korea says
summary: ZDNet Korea reports that KIS Information & Telecommunication said abnormal access on 18 November to its VAN business-support web server leaked 862 records (208 customers, 654 employees). NHN KCP said abnormal access on 17 November leaked 160 sales receipts. Digital Today also reports the NHN KCP case and says the Financial Services Commission reportedly summoned major PG firms. No attacker is named.
plain: ZDNet Korea reports two Korean payment companies said abnormal access leaked data: 862 records at KIS Information & Telecommunication and 160 sales receipts at NHN KCP.
exec: Two Korean payment firms say abnormal access leaked data: 862 records at KIS Information & Telecommunication and 160 sales receipts at NHN KCP, per ZDNet Korea.
action: No action needed; for awareness. NHN KCP says it has notified everyone concerned.

evidence.quote: KIS정보통신에서도 지난 18일 밴(VAN) 업무지원 웹 서비스 서버에 비정상적으로 접근해 고객 208건과 임직원 654건 등 총 862건의 정보 유출이 있음을 밝혔다.
NHN KCP에서는 지난 17일 오후 대고객 조회서비스 페이지에 대한 외부의 비정상적인 접근으로 매출전표 160건이 조회되는 사고가 발생했다.

validation.note: ZDNet Korea relays both companies' statements; Digital Today independently reports the NHN KCP 17 Nov, 160-receipt case but says of KIS only that a leak reportedly occurred, so the KIS figures stay single-source. Company notices not read.

review.note: Re-compared 18 Nov, 862 (208+654), 160 receipts, 17 Nov NHN KCP, notification, FSC report against ZDNet Korea and Digital Today; possible-duplicate is false: Welcome Payments is another company in the same Digital Today article
